messages.text: Morning. FOMC is tomorrow 2pm, so today is positioning. Curve is flat into the print, 2s10s barely moved overnight. Keep gross tight until we see how the dots shake out.
Fed funds futures pricing roughly 85% odds of a hold. Implied vol on front-end rates is bid, straddles look rich vs realized. Might be worth fading some of it.
Agree on rich. Realized on 2y has been sleepy the last two weeks. But skew says the market wants downside protection on the hawkish dots risk.
Don't fade anything size before the print. Small, defined risk only. Tails on a surprise dot plot will hurt more than the carry pays.
Risk here. Intraday VaR limit for the desk stays as is, but I'll be watching DV01 on rates and equity beta into tomorrow. Flag anything that pushes you over 80% of limit.
Copy. Current DV01 is about half of limit. Will send a snapshot at 3pm today and again at noon tomorrow.
Equities: SPX futures flat, tech lagging a touch. Breadth is thin. Feels like everyone's waiting. Volume is 20% below the 30-day average at this hour.
Thin tape is exactly when a headline gaps you. Make sure resting orders in OMS have sane limits and no stale GTCs from last week.
Ran an OMS sweep. Found three stale GTCs on the desk, all canceled. Nothing from the quants.
TradeBlotter P&L looks off for me. Showing the rates book up about 40k but the marks look a few ticks stale. Anyone else seeing it?
Same on my view. Probably the 8:45 refresh lagging. Hit refresh and it caught up for me, now showing 31k.
Use the blotter as directional only until the pricing refresh settles. I'll ping Tech if it drifts again.
Quick scenario ask: can the quants run +25bp and -25bp parallel shocks plus a 10bp bear steepener on the current book? Want it before the close.
On it. Should have all three by 1pm. Will include the equity delta overlay for a hawkish surprise scenario too.
Midday: 10y trading 2bp cheaper, dollar firmer, credit spreads unchanged. Real money seems to be staying sidelined. Nothing crazy yet.
Fine. Hold the line. We'll reassess after Jessica's scenarios land and decide if we trim into the close.
Scenarios posted in the risk folder. Worst case is the bear steepener, about 70% of the desk limit. Within bounds but not much cushion.
